evidence.excerpt_or_description: The theoretical helix geometry labels diameter D, spacing S, turn length L, pitch angle α, and total length A.
The axial-mode conditions relate the helix diameter, spacing, turns, and wavelength.

expected.summary: Represent the radiating helix as a source-parameterized helical wire path or sweep.
expected.acceptable_alternative: Use an explicit reconstruction-blocking unresolved item when the helix path cannot be recovered.
expected.forbidden_condition: Replacing the helix with an unrelated cylinder or planar ring.

assertions.review_instruction: Confirm that the path topology and parameter references reconstruct the source helix rather than only its envelope.

evidence.excerpt_or_description: The flight model is included in the Nadir Antenna and Deployment Subsystem and follows earlier engineering-model development.
The paper explicitly compares NADS flight-model measurements with engineering-model results.

expected.summary: Keep theoretical, prototype/engineering, and NADS flight-model versions separately identified.
expected.forbidden_condition: Merging geometry, materials, or results from different model versions into one undifferentiated design.

assertions.review_instruction: Trace each extracted design and result to the theoretical, engineering, or flight-model source section.

evidence.excerpt_or_description: The extruded NADS view identifies the integrated flight-model assembly.
The table is explicitly titled as measurements of the NADS Flight Model.

expected.summary: When the target is the delivered antenna, select the NADS flight model with explicit source evidence.
expected.acceptable_alternative: Keep target selection unresolved if the requested reconstruction target is not specified.
expected.forbidden_condition: Calling an earlier theoretical or engineering model the flight model.

assertions.review_instruction: Confirm that the selected architecture corresponds to the NADS flight model and that inherited parameters are source-backed.

evidence.excerpt_or_description: The NADS flight-model radiation pattern was measured in the UPC Antenna Lab anechoic chamber.
Frequency, directivity, gain, and FBR are identified as flight-model measurements.

expected.summary: Keep simulated results and measured flight-model results as separate origins.

verifiable_condition.target: antenna_results.json result origin and design reference
verifiable_condition.expected_text: Table 14 values are measured and associated with NADS Flight Model

evidence.excerpt_or_description: The NADS part materials include Aluminum 7075, brass, FR-4, and the helix antenna material as reported in the table.
Only the helix dimensions and relationships shown by the source are eligible for geometry parameters.

expected.summary: Use only dimensions and materials explicitly supported by the selected model's source evidence.
expected.forbidden_condition: Supplying unsupported dimensions or materials to make reconstruction appear complete.

verifiable_condition.expected_text: all dimensions and materials reference source evidence
